Ambiguity around how the spool header delimiter is formatted: if \r\n vs \n differences cause off-by-one byte slicing errors in binary stream ingestion.
Unclear CLI signature for /usr/local/bin/quant-reconcile-service: the instruction notes --batch-dir, but existing flags or arguments in deploy.sh must match test expectations exactly.
review.reasons: The scenario is realistic for high-performance financial data pipelines mixing binary accumulators, POSIX shared memory, SQLite WAL concurrency, and shell orchestration. fixes: Ensure stat_accumulator binary does not require AVX-512 or architecture-specific flags that could fail on virtualized CI runners lacking specific CPU extensions.

Clearly define the exact spool header protocol (e.g. 'ASCII header terminated by ---END-HEADER---\n followed immediately by raw binary struct array') in ingest_batch.sh documentation or comments so the offset calculation is unambiguous.
Ensure deploy.sh template explicitly outlines the expected CLI interface and flag syntax for /usr/local/bin/quant-reconcile-service.
